notes: Two lattice transmission towers of the line that crosses the campus south of the Student Recreation Center lot. Centres, heights (about 54 m), body widths and arm spans are from the LiDAR points (2017): body about 7.5 m wide 17 m above the ground and 2.3 m wide at 35 m, arms about 5.5 m long between 36 and 50 m. The two towers stand 21 m apart across the line, so the line direction is taken at right angles to the line between them (23.6 degrees). The conductors are not modelled.
